value.authorName: Not an Epstein survivor, but hurt by other terrible people.
value.message:
This is everything I didn't know that we needed. 

I've been so disappointed with politicians as ' allies' that will only speak when it helps them. 

And their truth is not the truth of anyone who survived sexual assaults. 

Your courage is shocking and the best possible way.
We will have revenge and accountability for you all! We won’t stop until he is dead or behind bars!
Stay strong and know so many Americans support you. This must be exhausting but these awful people need to be held accountable. We admire you all so much!
Thank you for your steadfast courage, unwavering strength against terrible odds. We love you,  we see you, you are us, we are all sisters ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Thank you for your continued strength courage. I am an incest survivor, and my father was never reported or held accountable for his actions. In fact, my family of 10 brothers and sisters turned their back on me when I spoke out I find great comfort in witnessing the courage of the Epstein survivors, no girl or woman should ever have to endure sexual abuse and sexual violence thank you thank you thank you I hope and pray that future generations of girls and women will no longer have to hold their tongues and be scared to speak you all are  so important both together and individually, and I support you with all of my heart and soul. I made the trip to Washington DC to support you at the first press conference with Marjorie Taylor Green present and I will continue to support you. However I can.
Thank you for standing up - it is extremely hard and you all have a lot of courage Lets get these people and throw them in the trash bin

Dear Survivor Sisters, 

You have all been incredibly brave. I hope that you all get to see some justice in the future. I wish you all the best for the future. 
Best wishes.
Much support from Missouri. Thank you for what you're doing!

YOU GO LADIES! Thank you for standing up for all the unspoken survivors! You guys to stand up for what’s right is what this world needs to get the bad out!
Thank you for all you are doing at your own expense and risk!
You are ALL doing GODS Work! Keep up the good fight!
